turns.text: People out here, they don't even know that the outside world exists.
turns.zh: 这地方的人，他们甚至不知道外面的世界存在。

turns.text: Might as well be living on the fucking moon.
turns.zh: 简直跟住在该死的月球上一样。

turns.text: There's all kinds of ghettos in the world.
turns.zh: 世界上到处都是贫民窟。

turns.text: It's all one ghetto, man.
turns.zh: 整个世界就是一个大贫民窟，老兄。

turns.text: Giant gutter in outer space.
turns.zh: 外太空里的巨型臭水沟。

turns.text: Today that scene...
turns.zh: 今天那个场景……

turns.text: That is the most fucked up thing I ever caught.
turns.zh: 那是我见过最操蛋的东西。

turns.text: That's you something...
turns.zh: 那是你的事……

turns.text: You're Christian, yeah?
turns.zh: 你是基督徒，对吧？

turns.text: No.
turns.zh: 不是。

turns.text: What do you got the cross for in your apartment?
turns.zh: 那你公寓里那个十字架是干嘛的？

turns.text: It's a form of meditation.
turns.zh: 那是一种冥想方式。

turns.text: How's that?
turns.zh: 怎么说？

turns.text: I contemplate the moment in the garden,
turns.zh: 我冥想花园里的那一刻，

turns.text: the idea of allowing your own crucifixion.
turns.zh: 那种允许自己被钉上十字架的想法。

turns.text: But you're not a Christian, so what do you believe?
turns.zh: 但你不是基督徒，那你信什么？

turns.text: I believe that people shouldn't talk about this type of shit at work.
turns.zh: 我相信人们不该在工作的时候聊这种破事。

turns.text: Hold on, hold on.
turns.zh: 等等，等等。

turns.text: Three months we've been together, I get nothing from you. People shouldn't talk about this type of shit at work. Hold on, hold on.
turns.zh: 我们在一起三个月了，我从你这儿什么都没得到。人们不该在工作的时候聊这种破事。等等，等等。

turns.text: Three months we've been together, I get nothing from you. Today, what we're into now, do me a courtesy, okay?
turns.zh: 我们在一起三个月了，我从你这儿什么都没得到。今天，我们现在聊的这个，给我个面子，行吗？

turns.text: I'm not trying to convert you.
turns.zh: 我不是想让你改变信仰。

turns.text: Look, I'd consider myself a realist, all right?
turns.zh: 听着，我自认为是个现实主义者，好吧？

turns.text: But in philosophical terms, I'm what's called a pessimist.
turns.zh: 但用哲学术语来说，我是所谓的悲观主义者。

turns.text: Um, okay, what's that mean?
turns.zh: 嗯，好吧，那是什么意思？

turns.text: - It means I'm bad at parties.
turns.zh: 意思是我不擅长派对。

turns.text: - [chuckles] What do we tell you?
turns.zh: （轻笑）我们该跟你说什么？

turns.text: You ain't great outside of parties either.
turns.zh: 你在派对之外也不怎么样。

turns.text: - I think human consciousness
turns.zh: 我觉得人类意识

turns.text: is a tragic misstep in evolution.
turns.zh: 是进化中的一个悲剧性失误。

turns.text: We became too self-aware.
turns.zh: 我们变得太有自我意识了。

turns.text: Nature created an aspect of nature separate from itself.
turns.zh: 自然创造出了自然中一个与自身分离的方面。

turns.text: We are creatures that should not exist by natural law.
turns.zh: 我们是按自然法则不该存在的生物。

turns.text: Hmm, that sounds... God-fucking-awful, Rush.
turns.zh: 嗯，那听起来……真他妈的糟糕，拉斯特。

turns.text: We are things that labor under the illusion of having a self.
turns.zh: 我们是那种在拥有自我的幻觉下劳作的生物。

turns.text: This accretion of sensory experience and feeling.
turns.zh: 这种感官经验和感觉的堆积。

turns.text: Programmed with total assurance that we are each somebody.
turns.zh: 被编程为完全确信我们每个人都是某个人物。

turns.text: When in fact, everybody's nobody.
turns.zh: 而事实上，每个人都不是谁。

turns.text: I wouldn't go around spouting that shit I was you.
turns.zh: 我要是你，就不会到处去散播这种鬼话。

turns.text: People around here don't think that way. I don't think that way.
turns.zh: 这附近的人不这么想。我也不这么想。

turns.text: I think the honorable thing for our species to do
turns.zh: 我觉得我们物种该做的体面事

turns.text: is deny our programming.
turns.zh: 就是拒绝我们的编程。

turns.text: Stop reproducing.
turns.zh: 停止繁殖。

turns.text: Walk hand in hand into extinction.
turns.zh: 手牵手走向灭绝。

turns.text: One last midnight, brothers and sisters
turns.zh: 最后一个午夜，兄弟姐妹们

turns.text: opting out of a raw deal.
turns.zh: 退出这场不公平的交易。

turns.text: So, what's the point of getting out of bed in the morning?
turns.zh: 那么，早上起床还有什么意义？

turns.text: I tell myself I bear witness.
turns.zh: 我告诉自己，我是在见证。

turns.text: The real answer is that it's obviously my programming.
turns.zh: 真正的答案是，这显然是我的编程。

turns.text: And I lack the Constitution for suicide.
turns.zh: 而且我缺乏自杀的体质。

turns.text: My luck. I picked today to get to know you.
turns.zh: 我的运气。我偏偏挑了今天来了解你。

turns.text: Three months, I don't hear a word from you and--
turns.zh: 三个月了，我都没听你说过一个字，而且——

turns.text: -You asked? -Yeah.
turns.zh: ——你问了吗？——问了。

turns.text: And now I'm begging you to shut the fuck up.
turns.zh: 现在我在求你他妈的闭嘴。

turns.text: I got a bad taste in my mouth out here.
turns.zh: 我在这儿嘴里有股怪味。

turns.text: Aluminum.
turns.zh: 铝。

turns.text: Hash.
turns.zh: 大麻。

turns.text: I think you can smell the psychosphere.
turns.zh: 我觉得你能闻到精神圈的味道。

turns.text: I got an idea.
turns.zh: 我有个主意。

turns.text: Let's make the car a place of silent reflection from now on.
turns.zh: 从现在起，让这辆车成为沉默反思的地方吧。

turns.text: Okay?
turns.zh: 好吗？

turns.text: What should I drink for dinner?
turns.zh: 晚饭我该喝什么？

turns.text: What should I drink for dinner?
turns.zh: 晚饭我该喝什么？

turns.text: A bottle of wine would be nice, I guess.
turns.zh: 一瓶葡萄酒应该不错，我想。

turns.text: I don't drink.
turns.zh: 我不喝酒。

turns.text: Oh, no, of course not, Russ.
turns.zh: 哦，不，当然不，拉斯特。

turns.text: Listen, when you're at my house, I want you to chill the fuck out.
turns.zh: 听着，你在我家的时候，我希望你他妈的放松点。

turns.text: Don't even mention any of that bullshit you just said to me.
turns.zh: 别再提你刚才跟我说的那些废话。

turns.text: - Of course not, Marty.
turns.zh: ——当然不会，马蒂。

turns.text: I'm not some kind of maniac, I ain't. For fuck's sake.
turns.zh: 我不是什么疯子，我不是。他妈的。
